text:
Type: geometric cotton tassel throw
Use: layering on an armchair, sofa or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: bohemian, contemporary, rustic
Materials: woven cotton, raised tufted motifs, large tassels
Colors: black, cream white
Shape: rectangular throw, bold Greek key and triangle global pattern, raised cream squares, oversized corner and edge tassels, substantial
Feel: graphic, bold, crafted
Goes with: cognac leather, warm wood, black and white rugs; bohemian or eclectic modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet High Contrast Black and White Global Geometric 100% Cotton Throw Blanket
product.description: High contrast black and white and oversized tassels make this throw a standout that can even be hung as wall art. Hand-woven and hand-tied, this global-inspired piece is also soft enough to use as a blanket or snuggle up in on the sofa. 50"W x 60"L Hand woven of 100% cotton Spot clean only.
